name: Zenobius the Grammarian
bio: Zenobius the Grammarian is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no firm date for the poet. Paton's index lists him as a grammarian.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 711).

poems.title: Book IX, 711
poems.author: Zenobius the Grammarian
poems.text: The painter wished to depict Grammar herself, and having painted Victor, said: “I have attained my end.”
